text: This audit found that the model misses significantly more true cases among some racial groups than others, with the largest gap being 0.312. The group the model most often overlooks is "Some other race alone," which has the lowest recall of 0.5420. Despite these differences, the overall accuracy stays nearly the same across all racial groups. A potential method to reduce these gaps was tested but not used because it requires knowing each person's race when making predictions. The model’s weaknesses in fairly treating different groups remain unaddressed.
